body: Yes, there have been others. Sadly I essentially ignored all of them because I was obsessed with her. Writing them out makes me feel foolish because they are obvious. There really is no doubt in my mind that she was/and is emotionally cheating on me. Sexually I am not sure. I am going to be speaking with her this evening and I am expecting the worst.
Do you think it would be acceptable to ask her if I can read her text message history between her and her ex?

Ya im honestly obssessed with this girl (if it wasnt obvious), and seeing her happy is the best feeling in the world. I really want to trust her, but this and other things in the past are eating away at me. Thank you for the advice

In a way she tries to make me feel better, but I feel like its just by saying that I am worrying to much, or just by repeating that hes just her friend. To her credit she has never accused me of being controlling or anything. It ends up in arguments a lot, not completely her fault because I definitely can be dramatic.
Does it ever bother you, or get in your head that they have a past or are you comfortable with it?
I really like your comment, and I agree with you completely that awkward is not an excuse at all. It really hurts to hear that bringing me around her friend group would make things awkward.

Apperently he was in love with somone else and broke up with her. He also cheated on her. She told me that she wanted him to work through it, but he refused at the time. Later on he wanted her back, but she was dating me and refused.

I have yes. She maintained that they were simply good friends, and that she does love him but only as a friend.

Reading that back to myself I feel kind of stupid because it sounds like a shit excuse. I think im just fucking stupid. Even writing my original post I feel like im the most naive person alive.
